quickbite-frontend/.package.json: project dependencies and npm scripts (dev, build, lint, test)
quickbite-frontend/..env.example: documented environment variable template (REACT_APP_API_URL, REACT_APP_SOCKET_URL, REACT_APP_MAPS_KEY)
quickbite-frontend/..eslintrc.js: ESLint config with import-order and no-restricted-imports rules
quickbite-frontend/..prettierrc: code style config aligned with backend .prettierrc
quickbite-frontend/.jest.config.js: Jest config for React Testing Library tests
quickbite-frontend/.vite.config.js: Vite bundler config with path aliases

src/.main.jsx: React app bootstrap — renders App into DOM, sets up QueryClient and global providers
src/.App.jsx: root component — declares react-router-dom routes for all four portal experiences
src/.tokens.css: CSS custom properties for all design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, radius, elevation)
src/.index.css: global reset and base styles referencing tokens.css variables

config/.env.js: reads and exports typed environment variables (API base URL, socket URL)
config/.queryClient.js: TanStack Query client instance with global defaults (stale time, retry)
config/.router.jsx: centralised react-router-dom createBrowserRouter definition for all routes

types/.user.types.js: User, Customer, Address type definitions mirroring User.model.js
types/.menu.types.js: MenuCategory, MenuItem type definitions mirroring Menu.model.js (incl. allergens)
types/.cart.types.js: Cart, CartItem type definitions mirroring Cart.model.js
types/.order.types.js: Order, OrderItem, OrderStatus enum mirroring Order.model.js state machine
types/.payment.types.js: Payment type definition mirroring Payment.model.js (tokens only, no card data)
types/.delivery.types.js: Delivery, LocationPing, DeliveryStatus enum mirroring Delivery.model.js
types/.admin.types.js: PlatformConfig, AdminAuditLog, Dispute type definitions mirroring admin models
types/.api.types.js: ApiResponse and ApiError envelope shapes matching backend ApiResponse/ApiError helpers

services/.apiClient.js: Axios instance with base URL, JWT Authorization header injection, and 401 refresh-token interceptor
services/.restaurantsService.js: calls GET /restaurants (browse+filter), GET /restaurants/search, GET /restaurants/:id, GET /restaurants/:id/menu, PATCH /restaurants/:id
services/.deliveryService.js: calls GET /delivery/jobs, PATCH /delivery/:id/status, POST /delivery/:id/location, GET /delivery/:id, POST /delivery/:id/proof
services/.adminService.js: calls all /admin/* endpoints: dashboard, restaurants, users, orders, payments, disputes, reviews, agents, config, audit-logs
services/.socketClient.js: Socket.IO client initialisation; exposes joinOrderRoom, joinDeliveryRoom, and event subscription helpers matching orders.events.js and delivery.events.js room patterns

auth/.useAuth.js: reads auth state from AuthContext; exposes user, role, isAuthenticated
auth/.useLogin.js: mutation hook wrapping authService.login with error handling

users/.useAddressActions.js: mutation hooks for create, update, and delete address

restaurants/.useRestaurants.js: query hook for GET /restaurants with filter and sort params

menu/.useMenuMutations.js: mutation hooks for category and item create, update, delete, and availability toggle

cart/.useCartActions.js: mutation hooks for add item, update quantity, remove item, and clear cart

orders/.useOrderSocket.js: subscribes to Socket.IO order:{orderId} room for real-time status events

delivery/.useDeliveryJobs.js: query hook for GET /delivery/jobs (agent job queue)
delivery/.useDeliveryActions.js: mutation hooks for status update, location ping, and proof-of-delivery upload
delivery/.useDeliverySocket.js: subscribes to Socket.IO delivery:{deliveryId} room for live location events

admin/.useAdminDashboard.js: query hook for admin dashboard stats endpoint
admin/.useAdminRestaurants.js: query and mutation hooks for admin restaurant list, detail, onboard, suspend, reactivate
admin/.useAdminUsers.js: query and mutation hooks for admin user list and detail
admin/.useAdminOrders.js: query hook for admin order list and detail
admin/.useAdminPayments.js: query hook for admin payment/transaction list and detail
admin/.useAdminDisputes.js: query and mutation hooks for dispute list, detail, and resolution
admin/.useAdminReviews.js: query and mutation hooks for review list and removal
admin/.useAdminAgents.js: query and mutation hooks for delivery agent list, detail, and status
admin/.useAdminConfig.js: query and mutation hooks for GET/PATCH platform config
admin/.useAdminAuditLog.js: query hook for admin audit log endpoint

hooks/.useGeolocation.js: browser Geolocation API hook for customer address detection and agent location pings
hooks/.useCamera.js: MediaDevices getUserMedia hook for delivery-agent proof-of-delivery photo capture
hooks/.useDebounce.js: generic debounce hook used for search inputs
hooks/.usePagination.js: generic pagination state hook for paginated list views

context/.AuthContext.jsx: provides auth state (user, token, role) and login/logout actions; persists JWT to storage
context/.CartContext.jsx: provides active cart state and item-count badge across the customer app

layouts/.CustomerLayout.jsx: top nav with address selector, cart icon, and account menu; wraps all customer pages
layouts/.RestaurantPortalLayout.jsx: sidebar nav for restaurant portal pages; shows live order alert badge
layouts/.AgentLayout.jsx: minimal top bar for delivery agent pages; high-contrast variant
layouts/.AdminLayout.jsx: sidebar nav for admin console; shows role-restricted nav items
layouts/.AuthLayout.jsx: centered card layout shared by all login/register/reset pages

auth/.LoginPage.jsx: customer /login — email/phone + password form with lockout messaging
auth/.RegisterPage.jsx: customer /register — registration form with email/mobile and password
auth/.ResetPasswordPage.jsx: /reset-password — new password form consuming reset token from URL

customer/.HomePage.jsx: / — address selector, open-restaurant listing with filter and sort controls
customer/.SearchResultsPage.jsx: /search — search results for restaurants and menu items by name/cuisine
customer/.RestaurantDetailPage.jsx: /restaurants/:restaurantId — menu, hours, rating, delivery info, add-to-cart
customer/.CartPage.jsx: /cart — cart item list, totals, minimum-order validation, proceed to checkout
customer/.CheckoutPage.jsx: /checkout — delivery/pickup toggle, saved address selector, order summary
customer/.PaymentPage.jsx: /checkout/payment — payment method selection (card via gateway tokenization, wallet, cash)
customer/.OrderHistoryPage.jsx: /orders — paginated list of customer order history
customer/.OrderDetailPage.jsx: /orders/:orderId — live order status, tracking map, cancel button, ETA
customer/.SubmitReviewPage.jsx: /orders/:orderId/review — 1-5 star rating and optional text review form
customer/.ProfilePage.jsx: /profile — view and edit customer profile details
customer/.AddressesPage.jsx: /profile/addresses — list of saved addresses with edit and delete
customer/.AddAddressPage.jsx: /profile/addresses/new — form to add a new delivery address
customer/.EditAddressPage.jsx: /profile/addresses/:addressId/edit — form to edit an existing address

restaurant/.RestaurantDashboardPage.jsx: /restaurant/dashboard — summary stats, open/closed toggle, recent orders
restaurant/.RestaurantOrderQueuePage.jsx: /restaurant/orders — real-time incoming order list with accept/reject actions
restaurant/.RestaurantOrderDetailPage.jsx: /restaurant/orders/:orderId — order detail with status advance controls
restaurant/.MenuManagementPage.jsx: /restaurant/menu — category and item list with availability toggles
restaurant/.MenuCategoryCreatePage.jsx: /restaurant/menu/categories/new — form to create a new menu category
restaurant/.MenuItemCreatePage.jsx: /restaurant/menu/categories/:categoryId/items/new — form to create a menu item incl. allergens
restaurant/.MenuItemEditPage.jsx: /restaurant/menu/categories/:categoryId/items/:itemId/edit — form to edit a menu item
restaurant/.RestaurantSettingsPage.jsx: /restaurant/settings — restaurant profile, delivery radius, hours, and availability

agent/.AgentDashboardPage.jsx: /agent/dashboard — available job queue; single-tap accept action per NFR-6
agent/.AgentActiveJobPage.jsx: /agent/deliveries/:deliveryId — active delivery: map, pickup/dropoff detail, status update, proof-of-delivery capture

admin/.AdminRestaurantListPage.jsx: /admin/restaurants — searchable restaurant list with status filters
admin/.AdminUserListPage.jsx: /admin/users — searchable user list across all roles
admin/.AdminOrderListPage.jsx: /admin/orders — searchable order list with status filters
admin/.AdminOrderDetailPage.jsx: /admin/orders/:orderId — order detail view for admin oversight
admin/.AdminDisputeDetailPage.jsx: /admin/disputes/:orderId — dispute detail with resolution form and refund trigger
admin/.AdminReviewListPage.jsx: /admin/reviews — review moderation list with remove action
admin/.AdminAgentListPage.jsx: /admin/agents — delivery agent list with status management
admin/.AdminConfigPage.jsx: /admin/config — platform config form (commission rate, service fee, delivery radius)
admin/.AdminAuditLogPage.jsx: /admin/audit-logs — paginated audit log with actor and entity filters

ui/.Button.jsx: primary, secondary, and destructive button variants using color tokens and 44px min tap target
ui/.Input.jsx: text input with inline error display using color-error token
ui/.Select.jsx: dropdown select control styled to design tokens
ui/.RadioGroup.jsx: radio button group for mutually exclusive options
ui/.Badge.jsx: pill badge using color-secondary or status colors; radius-pill token
ui/.Skeleton.jsx: skeleton placeholder for loading card and list states
ui/.Modal.jsx: accessible dialog with radius-lg and elevation-2 tokens
ui/.Sheet.jsx: bottom-sheet for mobile overlays (cart summary, filter panel)
ui/.Toast.jsx: transient notification snackbar for success and error feedback
ui/.Card.jsx: content card with elevation-1, radius-md tokens
ui/.StarRating.jsx: interactive and read-only 1-5 star rating control
ui/.QuantityStepper.jsx: increment/decrement control for cart item quantities with 44px targets
ui/.EmptyState.jsx: empty list or error illustration with call-to-action
ui/.ErrorMessage.jsx: inline field-level error text using color-error

navigation/.TopNavBar.jsx: shared top navigation bar with help link and account menu per layout standards
navigation/.CustomerNavBar.jsx: customer-specific nav with address display and cart icon badge
navigation/.RestaurantSidebar.jsx: restaurant portal sidebar navigation with order alert badge
navigation/.AgentTopBar.jsx: minimal top bar for delivery agent app
navigation/.BottomNavBar.jsx: mobile bottom tab bar for customer and agent apps
navigation/.ProtectedRoute.jsx: RBAC-aware route wrapper; redirects unauthorized users based on role
navigation/.GuestRoute.jsx: redirects authenticated users away from auth pages

restaurants/.RestaurantCard.jsx: card showing restaurant name, cuisine, rating, delivery time, fee, and min order
restaurants/.RestaurantHero.jsx: hero image and key info header on restaurant detail page
restaurants/.RestaurantStatusBadge.jsx: open/closed/unavailable badge using status color tokens
restaurants/.FilterPanel.jsx: cuisine, price range, rating, and delivery-time filter controls

menu/.MenuCategorySection.jsx: section header and item list for one menu category
menu/.MenuItemCard.jsx: menu item with name, description, price, allergen badges, and add-to-cart button
menu/.MenuItemAvailabilityToggle.jsx: manager-facing availability switch per menu item
menu/.AllergenBadge.jsx: small badge per allergen/dietary flag per NFR-5
menu/.MenuItemForm.jsx: shared form for create and edit menu item (name, description, price, allergens, availability)
menu/.MenuCategoryForm.jsx: shared form for create and edit menu category

cart/.CartDrawer.jsx: slide-in cart panel showing items, totals, and checkout CTA
cart/.CartItemRow.jsx: single cart item row with quantity stepper and remove button
cart/.CartSummary.jsx: subtotal, taxes, delivery fee, and total breakdown block
cart/.MinOrderAlert.jsx: inline alert showing shortfall to restaurant minimum order value

orders/.OrderStatusStepper.jsx: visual step indicator for order status sequence (Accepted → Delivered)
orders/.OrderCard.jsx: order summary card for history list
orders/.OrderItemList.jsx: read-only list of items and quantities in an order
orders/.OrderActions.jsx: context-sensitive action buttons (cancel, rate) based on order status and role
orders/.RestaurantOrderCard.jsx: incoming order card for restaurant queue with accept/reject controls
orders/.OrderStatusAdvance.jsx: restaurant-side button to advance order to Preparing and Ready states

tracking/.LiveTrackingMap.jsx: map component showing delivery agent live location and route polyline (uses Mapping API data)
tracking/.ETADisplay.jsx: updated ETA countdown shown during Out for Delivery status
tracking/.AgentLocationMarker.jsx: map marker representing the delivery agent's current position

payment/.PaymentMethodSelector.jsx: card, digital wallet, and cash-on-delivery option selector
payment/.PaymentStatusBanner.jsx: banner showing payment success, failure, or pending state
payment/.GatewayTokenField.jsx: iframe or hosted-field wrapper for PCI-compliant gateway tokenization; no raw card data handled by app

reviews/.ReviewForm.jsx: star rating selector and optional text review textarea with submit
reviews/.ReviewList.jsx: list of reviews for a restaurant with rating and text
reviews/.ReviewCard.jsx: single review display with rating, text, and moderation action for admin

delivery/.JobCard.jsx: available delivery job card with restaurant, destination, and single-tap accept button
delivery/.ActiveDeliveryCard.jsx: active job summary shown on agent dashboard
delivery/.ProofOfDeliveryUploader.jsx: camera capture and file upload for proof-of-delivery photo using useCamera hook
delivery/.StatusUpdateButton.jsx: single-tap status update control per NFR-6 minimal-interaction requirement

admin/.StatsCard.jsx: metric card for admin dashboard KPIs
admin/.DataTable.jsx: generic paginated and sortable data table for admin list views
admin/.DisputeResolutionForm.jsx: form to record dispute resolution outcome and trigger refund
admin/.OnboardRestaurantForm.jsx: multi-step form for restaurant partner onboarding
admin/.PlatformConfigForm.jsx: form for commission rate, service fee, and delivery radius config
admin/.AuditLogTable.jsx: specialised table for audit log entries with actor, action, entity, and timestamp columns
admin/.UserStatusControl.jsx: suspend/reactivate control for users and agents

common/.AddressSelector.jsx: dropdown to select from saved addresses or prompt to add a new one
common/.AddressForm.jsx: shared address input form used in profile and checkout flows
common/.SearchBar.jsx: debounced search input with clear control used across customer and admin pages
common/.PageHeader.jsx: consistent page title and optional breadcrumb row
common/.ConfirmDialog.jsx: reusable confirmation modal for destructive actions
common/.NotificationToast.jsx: maps Socket.IO order/delivery events to toast notifications for real-time feedback
common/.PaginationControls.jsx: previous/next and page number controls for paginated list views
common/.RoleBadge.jsx: badge indicating user role (Customer, Manager, Agent, Admin)

utils/.formatCurrency.js: formats numeric amounts to locale currency string
utils/.formatDate.js: formats ISO date strings to human-readable labels
utils/.formatDistance.js: formats distance values from mapping API responses
utils/.orderStatusHelpers.js: maps OrderStatus enum values to display labels and color tokens
utils/.deliveryStatusHelpers.js: maps DeliveryStatus enum values to display labels
utils/.cartCalculations.js: client-side subtotal, tax, delivery fee, and total recalculation
utils/.validationSchemas.js: Zod/Yup schemas for all frontend forms, mirroring backend validation shapes
utils/.addressHelpers.js: formats address objects into display strings
utils/.storage.js: localStorage/sessionStorage helpers for JWT and cart persistence

assets/.fonts/: Poppins and Inter font files (woff2) loaded via tokens.css
assets/.icons/: SVG icon set for UI controls (cart, star, location, status indicators)
